title: cerinthe aspera subsp. gymnandra
intro: Cerinthe aspera subsp. gymnandra, commonly known as Honeywort, is a flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Cerinthe aspera subsp. gymnandra are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic effects, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
